units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 8a:11">Bekh. 8ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:3">Gen. R. s. 20</cite>, beg.—Du. <he>אֲחוֹרַיִים</he> (Ar. <he>אחורים</he>).
<cite ref="Pesachim 17b:9">Pes. 17ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>א׳ ותוך</he> the back (outside) and the inside of a vessel.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 5:2:3">Y. Yoma V, 42ᶜ</cite> top <he>אֲחוֹרָיו לקדש</he> his back turned to the sanctuary.—
Y. Pes. VI, 33ᵃ bot., a. fr. מֵאֲחוֹרֵי (prepos.) behind.—אֲחוֹרֵי, לַאֲחוֹרֵי same.

senses.gloss: last. Ib. (ref. to Ps. CXXXIX, 5) א׳ למעשה וכ׳ the last of all things created; Lev. R. s. 14 א׳ לכל המעשים.
farthest back, earliest. Ib. א׳ זה יום ראשון aḥor (Ps. l. c.) means the first day.
